nos_units.nos_title: Overview on Road Design and Construction

modules.module_title: Overview on Road Design and Construction — Core Assessment Criteria

pcs.pc_description: Assess the basic understanding of road construction principles
Evaluate proficiency in conducting topographic surveys using GPS, Total Station, and Auto Level, including accurate site setting out.
Assess an overall knowledge of DPR Preparation
Assess the knowledge in interpretation of Drawings in the DPR
Evaluate the proficiency in the Geometric and Pavement Design
Assess the knowledge about Labour Laws, Project Management- CPM, PERT , MS Project, Primavera, Building Information Modeling (BIM)

nos_units.nos_title: Overview of Construction Tools, Machinery and Practices

modules.module_title: Overview of Construction Tools, Machinery and Practices — Core Assessment Criteria

pcs.pc_description: Evaluate the understanding of Quality Management Plan -Setting up of Field laboratory, Quality Assurance & Quality Control
Assess the understanding of Site Clearance- Earthwork, Erosion Control and Drainage- Quality Control

Assess the knowledge of Construction Tools and Machinery- Types, Applications, Suitability and Selection. Assess the knowledge on Full Depth Reclamation (FDR), precast pavements, white topping and surface dressing
Evaluate the knowledge of Material Selection and Management, utility management

nos_units.nos_title: Construction of Embankment and Granular Layers

modules.module_title: Construction of Embankment and Granular Layers — Core Assessment Criteria

pcs.pc_description: Check the understanding of Embankment and Subgrade - Design Criteria, Construction and Quality Control
Assess the knowledge about Field and Laboratory Testing of Soil, Aggregates and Other Additives/ Stabilizing Agents
Assess the understanding of Earth Retaining Works- Types, Basic Design Principles and Construction Practices
Assess the knowledge about Sub-Bases, Bases (Non-Bituminous) and Shoulder - Types, Material Specifications and Construction Practices

nos_units.nos_title: Construction of Pavement Upper Layers and Safety

modules.module_title: Construction of Pavement Upper Layers and Safety — Core Assessment Criteria

pcs.pc_description: Assess the knowledge about Bituminous Bases and Surface Courses - Specifications and Construction Practices. Evaluate Local/New/Alternate/Modified Construction Materials and Technologies - Use of Waste Plastic, Full Depth Reclamation (FDR), Reclaimed Asphalt Pavement (RAP) etc; Bitumen testing- and Test on mixes- Marshall stability, etc.
Evaluate the knowledge of Concrete Pavement - Specification and Construction Practices
Understanding of Traffic Signs, Markings and Other Road Appurtenances
Understanding of Construction Equipments and Machinery for base and surface courses

nos_units.nos_title: Geotechnical Investigations, Construction of Bridges and

modules.module_title: Geotechnical Investigations, Construction of Bridges and — Core Assessment Criteria

pcs.pc_description: • Assess the knowledge of Surface and Sub- Surface Geotechnical Investigations- Principles • and Practices
Access knowledge of Foundations - Types, Material Specifications, Testing and Construction Practices
Evaluate the understanding of Construction of Substructures and Super Structures of Bridges and Cross Drainage Structures, Formworks
Evaluate Steel Reinforcement, Prestressing, Bearings, Expansion Joints, Appurtenances, Repair and Retrofitting of Structures
Access the knowledge of the Completion of Work and Site Handing Over

nos_units.nos_title: Health and Safety in Road construction

modules.module_title: Health and Safety in Road construction — Core Assessment Criteria

pcs.pc_description: Evaluate the knowledge of Safety Practices in Construction
Evaluate the knowledge of Precautionary Measures for Safeguarding the Environment, Traffic Management Measures During Construction
